modes.normal: Keys move and act. The status bar shows NORMAL.
modes.insert: Keys go to a text field or the agent's terminal. The status bar shows INSERT.

act.o / ↵: Attach to the agent's terminal; from Overview, open its chat in insert mode

mode.i: Message the selected agent (insert mode), from any view
mode.esc: Normal mode, from anywhere; closes the open dialog
mode.esc esc: Send both Esc presses to the agent to interrupt it
